name: Cursed Upon Death (madness check)
description: A sorcerer who dies without cursed energy returns as a Vengeful cursed spirit a week later (see Rules → Optional Rules).

results.name: Weekly DC 25 Wisdom save
results.description: Weekly DC 25 Wisdom save — Failure: gain one level of indefinite madness and repeat next week. Success: lose all madness levels from this and stop saving.
